categories.evidence: Labeled Wallet and modifies wallet rebroadcast logic in src/wallet/wallet.cpp and test/functional/wallet_resendwallettransactions.py.
categories.rationale: Suppresses redundant rebroadcasts of transactions already present in the mempool to prevent leaking node IP and transaction ownership. Rebroadcasting transactions unconditionally signals wallet ownership to peers, a longstanding privacy issue noted in #36403 and #3828.
